text.p: Shareholders of Shanghai Haixin Co, a textile maker, has approved a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.35 yuan per share based on the company's 1996 net profit, a company statement said on Tuesday.
The dividend for foreign currency B shares will be exchanged into U.S. dollars at a rate of 8.2943 yuan to one dollar, the statement said.
Ex-dividend date for all shares will be June 16, it said.
Haixin reported a post-tax profit of 75.139 million yuan for 1996, up 53.81 percent from 48.851 million yuan in 1995, based on international accounting standards.
According to domestic accounting standards, the company posted a 1996 net profit of 75.90 million yuan, against a net profit of 54.142 million yuan in 1995.

Returns from the company's investment in three subsidiary firms in the past few years, plus successful technical upgrades, were the major factors boosting the company's profits in 1996, the annual report said.
